title: Cone-beam computed tomography-based deep learning-augmented model for screening sleep-disordered breathing risk
html: Sleep-disordered breathing (SDB) is a common but underdiagnosed disorder due to complex diagnostic procedures, posing a substantial global health burden. Craniofacial anatomy, such as mandibular retrusion and upper airway narrowing, plays a prominent role in SDB among Asian populations, underscoring the potential role of orthodontists in SDB risk screening. This study aimed to develop a deep learning-augmented, cone-beam computed tomography-based model for SDB risk screening in adults.
